ping.description: Round trip that touches nothing in Lightroom.

status.description: Lightroom version, current module and number of selected photos.

errors.plugin_not_connected: The BatchLight plugin is not connected. Make sure Lightroom Classic is open and that BatchLight is installed and enabled in File > Plug-in Manager, then call lightroom_status again.
errors.protocol_mismatch: The Lightroom plugin speaks bridge protocol {plugin_protocol} but this server speaks {server_protocol}. Reinstall the plugin from this server version (batchlight-mcp install-plugin), then reload it in Plug-in Manager.
errors.timeout: Lightroom did not answer '{action}' within {seconds} seconds. It may be busy (for example exporting or showing a dialog). If this was an edit it may still have been applied, so check with get_develop_settings before retrying.
errors.expired: The '{action}' command waited too long to start and was cancelled before Lightroom ran it. Nothing was changed. Try again.
errors.unknown_action: This Lightroom plugin does not know the action '{action}'. The plugin and server versions probably differ; reinstall the plugin and reload it in Plug-in Manager.
errors.bad_request: The Lightroom plugin rejected a malformed '{action}' command. This is a bug in BatchLight; details are in the local log.
errors.handler_failed: Lightroom reported an error while running '{action}'. Details are in the local log (never sent to the AI).
errors.hub_unavailable: Could not reach or start the BatchLight bridge on this computer. Restart your AI client; if it keeps happening, check the local log.
errors.hub_changed: The BatchLight bridge restarted while '{action}' was in flight. It is safe to call the same tool again.
errors.internal_error: BatchLight hit an internal error. Details are in the local log (never sent to the AI).
